title: Credits access control
subject: credits
summary: Who can see, manage, create and grant credits: the credits rules in the access-control DSL and the roles that hold them.

purpose.intro: Who can see, manage, create and grant credits is decided in the access-control DSL, `shared/configs/access-control/index.ts`, never by checks in the slice. The slice asks the engine for a verdict on its three entities: `credit_account`, `member_allowance` and `credit_lot`. Lots and the ledger belong to an account, so a read or a write on them is proven on the account first.

reference.statement: The roles that carry a credits permission, from the role forests in the same file; `// …` stands for permissions of other slices. An owner role holds everything its children hold.

reference.statement: The same rules, read as people and pages.

claims.text: **Everyone signed in** manages their own credits, in Settings (`manage_own_credits`), and sees their own allocation in the active organization (`read_own_allowance`). For a plain member, that allocation is all they ever see of the organization's credits.

**In a company**, the Owner and Manage Billing see the balance, the lots and the ledger, and set members' allocations (`manage_credits_company`). No company role may create credits, so a company's allocations spend what it bought. Managers and Standard members see only their own allocation.

**In a musical project**, the Owner manages the credits and the allocations, and an allocation there may create its credits (`manage_credits_musical_project`, `create_credits_musical_project`). Members see only their own allocation.

**In the platform admin organization**, only the Platform Owner grants credits and sees the grants made so far (`grant_credits_platform`). It is the owner's own permission, not one a delegated role carries. Who they can pick is who they may read: the user-organization slice's name search is row-scoped, and the Platform Owner reads every profile and organization (`read_all_profiles_platform`, `read_all_organizations_platform`).

**How the slice asks:** reading credits resolves a read scope on `credit_account`; changing an allocation needs an update verdict on `credit_account`; whether an allocation may create credits is the create verdict on `member_allowance`; a grant is the create verdict on `credit_lot`.

reference.statement: Edit the DSL, never the slice's services.

claims.text: **Let companies create credits:** add `create_credits_company` (entity `member_allowance`, action `create`, context `IN_COMPANY`) and give it to `company_billing`.
**A new organization type with credits:** add `manage_credits_<type>` and, if its allocations should create credits, `create_credits_<type>`, then give them to the type's roles.
